scope.description: Webshop platforms that Dutch wholesalers, technical wholesalers, e-tailers and specialist retailers consider instead of Highbiza.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: platforms Highbiza itself compares against (Magento/Adobe Commerce, WooCommerce, Shopify), the German open-commerce platform Shopware with its B2B components (a common re-platforming target for Benelux mid-market merchants leaving Magento), Dutch B2B commerce specialists (Sana Commerce, Propeller) and Dutch SaaS webshop builders with B2B options (CCV Shop, Lightspeed). Excluded: implementation agencies and Katapull siblings. Logic4's built-in webshop overlaps with Highbiza within the group and is noted, not listed.
scope.notes: Business stats are given only where an official primary source was found; most competitors are private and publish no comparable figures. Adobe does not report Adobe Commerce separately, so its stat is the wider Digital Experience segment. Sana Commerce and CCV Shop publish no company-wide figures. Highbiza publishes no revenue.

players.name: Shopify
players.description: SaaS commerce platform with B2B features in Shopify Plus; Highbiza describes it as user-friendly but limited in customisation and dependent on its app store.

businessStats.sourceTitle: Shopify Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025

players.name: Adobe Commerce (Magento)
players.description: Open-source Magento and its commercial Adobe Commerce edition; the platform many Highbiza customers leave, described by Highbiza as powerful but heavy and maintenance-intensive.

businessStats.scope: Adobe Digital Experience segment (Adobe Commerce is reported within it, alongside Experience Manager, Analytics and other products; not disclosed separately)
businessStats.sourceTitle: Adobe Reports Record Q4 and FY2025 Revenue (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)

players.name: WooCommerce
players.description: WordPress e-commerce plug-in; Highbiza argues dependence on many plug-ins creates risk and maintenance.

players.name: Shopware
players.description: German open-source and cloud commerce platform with B2B components (customer-specific pricing, quotes, quick order, employee accounts); a frequent re-platforming choice for Benelux mid-market wholesalers and brands leaving Magento, competing with Highbiza's Core and Enterprise tiers.

businessStats.scope: share of the 1,000 most relevant B2C online shops in Germany using Shopware (EHI Retail Institute, E-Commerce Report Germany 2026)
businessStats.sourceTitle: For the Fifth Year in a Row: Shopware Remains the Market Leader in Germany among Commerce Platforms in 2026

players.name: Sana Commerce
players.description: ERP-integrated B2B e-commerce for manufacturers and distributors on SAP and Microsoft Dynamics; competes for ERP-centric wholesalers.

players.name: Propeller
players.description: Composable B2B commerce cloud with customer-specific catalogues and pricing, quotes and AI sales agents; targets mid-market wholesalers and manufacturers.

businessStats.period: cumulative, as stated on website, October 2026
businessStats.scope: revenue generated for Propeller customers (currency not stated)

players.name: CCV Shop
players.description: Dutch SaaS webshop builder with templates, B2B and retail options and a free trial; competes at the Launch/Core end.

players.name: Lightspeed
players.description: Retail POS with integrated eCom; competes for retailers and jewellers who want shop and store in one, where Katapull answers with Vendit plus Highbiza.

businessStats.sourceTitle: Lightspeed Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2026 Financial Results
